name: zinn-identity
description: Declares Claude Code identity to Zinn in the environment of each Bash or Monitor shell: ZINN_SESSION_ID (the conversation), and for the one loop whose call is in flight ZINN_THREAD_ID (a subagent's agentId, unset on the main loop), ZINN_AGENT, ZINN_MODEL, ZINN_EFFORT. When calls of two loops are in flight at once the per-loop four are left unset rather than guessed. Environment only: no tool, no prompt section, no command, no drawing, so it costs no tokens. Never touches AI_AGENT.

enabled.title: Declare identity
enabled.description: Off registers no hook: no ZINN_* variable is written.

log.title: Decision log
log.description: Write each decision as JSONL to the folder below: loop ids, model, effort and which variables were written, never a command or transcript text. ZINN_IDENTITY_LOG=1 turns it on too.

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Absolute folder for the decision log. Empty: <home>/.zinn/traces/zinn-identity, where <home> is HOME then USERPROFILE. Never a folder inside the plugin tree (a --plugin-dir session watches it and reloads).
